## Lectures and Labs

If you have a question during lecture or lab, feel free to ask it! There are likely other students with the same question, so by asking you will create a learning opportunity for everyone.

## Office Hours

Office hours are your time, and I like it when you use them. Many questions are easier to sort out in person. Come by at least once in the first few days of a course, even if it's only to say hi. My office is West 311.

See your course syllabus for current office hours or email Professor George at [tgeorge\@cornellcollege.edu](mailto:tgeorge@cornellcollege.edu).

#### Professor Email

If you can't make office hours, or a question comes up in the evening, email me at [tgeorge\@cornellcollege.edu](mailto:tgeorge@cornellcollege.edu). If it's about code, we'll probably need to meet so I can see what you're seeing. Please reach out with any concern, large or small.

## Academic Support

### **Quantitative Reasoning Studio (QRS)**

Sometimes you need help outside class, or need something explained a different way. The [Quantitative Reasoning Studio (QRS)](https://www.cornellcollege.edu/library/ctl/qr/) in Cole Library room 322 offers free tutoring to all Cornell students. There is usually a peer tutor who has taken your statistics course. Email [QRS\@cornellcollege.edu](mailto:QRS@cornellcollege.edu "QRS@cornellcollege.edu") to ask when that tutor is working, or check the schedule posted in the studio.

### QRS Hours

| Day(s)          | Times                                |
|-----------------|--------------------------------------|
| Monday-Thursday | 8 a.m. - 5 p.m. and 7 p.m. - 10 p.m. |
| Friday          | 8 a.m. - 5 p.m.                      |
| Sunday          | 3 p.m. - 5 p.m. and 7 p.m. - 10 p.m. |

### Dungy Writing Studio

For help with your writing, visit the [Dungy Writing Studio](https://www.cornellcollege.edu/library/ctl/writing-studio/writing-studio-staff.shtml). You can make online appointments individually or in groups to get help with items such as your group project. If you have any questions about the studio, email Dungy Writing Studio Director and Director of Fellowships and Scholarships, Laura Farmer, at [lfarmer\@cornellcollege.edu](mailto:lfarmer@cornellcollege.edu).

### Writing Studio Hours

### Academic Support Services

There are a variety of support services offered to all students. See more information at: <https://www.cornellcollege.edu/academics/support-services/index.shtml>

## Ebersole Health and Wellbeing Center

The mission of Cornell College Student Health Services complements the mission of the college by promoting the optimal well-being of students. We do this by:

- providing and coordinating quality health care services
- advocating for students in their pursuit of health and wellness
- preparing students to be their own health advocates and informed consumers of appropriate health care services
- providing health education to promote the development of healthy lifestyles

The Student Health Center is located in the Ebersole Building, directly south of the Thomas Commons. Appointments are preferred. You can schedule an appointment online or by phone at 319-895-4292. Walk-ins will be accommodated as time permits. Appointments with the nurse are free.

## Technology Support

If your computer gives you trouble during the block, IT may be able to help. [Please submit a ticket](https://www.cornellcollege.edu/information-technology/). Tell me too, so we can work around it.
